name: loop-kit
description: Loop control and autonomous-completion plugins that work in both Claude Code and ChipAgents (--type claude)

plugins.name: goal-gate
plugins.description: Keeps the agent working until every item of the project's goal checklist is done, with a no-progress cutoff.

plugins.name: review-gate
plugins.description: Automatic peer review after every agent turn. In ChipAgents a bash post_turn hook runs a read-only reviewer (chipagents batch) over the declared scope and exits 1 with the findings to force a rework (opt-in: REVIEW_GATE=1, REVIEW_GATE_PATHS); in Claude Code it provides the turn-reviewer agent.

plugins.name: nonstop
plugins.description: Autonomous work mode with pre-flight risk assessment, dangerous-ops approval and a blocker decision framework, enforced by a stop hook.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Skills library: brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic debugging, code review and verification before completion. ChipAgents bootstrap rule added.
